description:
A team workspace for running AI coding agents in parallel with isolated Git worktrees, live diff review, GitHub integration, and mobile access.

Lody is a team agent workspace: share coding agents with your team on phone and desktop. Shared sessions, live diffs, and one control plane keep your team and agents in sync.
Run agents in parallel with isolated Git worktrees and live diff review, use subscriptions you already have with Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Kimi, and any agent that speaks ACP, manage the same control plane in the terminal with CLI commands, and ship together in one workspace with shared sessions, usage by member, and PR, CI, and merge status in-session.
Version 0.97.0
✨ New Features
- Pasting a session link into the composer turns it into a session mention; use Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+V to paste a plain link.
- Desktop Settings > Projects is now a two-pane catalog: GitHub / machines on the left, folders for the selected source on the right; click a folder to edit it.
- Queued messages can be steered directly (not just the first item when the agent supports acknowledged steering); Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Enter temporarily flips queue vs steer for that send.
🐛 Fixes & Improvements
- Fix DeepSeek Harness and other agents that load unsigned native addons failing to start on the signed macOS desktop.
- The mobile session menu can share a conversation as an image.
- On a narrow conversation column, the IDE and share actions move into the ⋯ menu.
